summary: Final record-tightening update, validated and submitted. Two changes: the VerifyLeader question is marked explained now that its gap is answered and its interpretation asserts the scoped claim over two executions of the fixed extended-window experiment plus the pre-window controls, with the residual boundary stated (the isolated near_node_self_voter field of that harness was refuted as a systematic lag by the discriminating experiment and cannot change the result, since the quorum arithmetic and vote registration both read the leader's own configuration); and the extended-window durable fact is supplemented with the repeat receipt f8a32ad3a4de41538ef20a142ae947bc so it rests on two independent executions of the same indices, with its statement, conditions and sources unchanged. The run's three lines are now complete and coherent: VerifyLeader can be confirmed by a non-voter's acknowledgement and stays wrong for the whole configured lease even after another node leads and commits writes the old leader never received (asserted); the suspected demotion view lag was refuted across seven sampled runs and its question closed; and LeadershipTransferToServer aimed at a non-voter reports success indistinguishable from a real handover while the sitting leadership is interrupted and a fresh election decides the outcome, bounded by the observed recovery (asserted). No further experiment was submitted, since the remaining allocation would not cover executing and interpreting another receipt.
